stem: During handoff, the outgoing technician reports that Batch B17 is on hold and irrigation ticket M-44 is open before the 18:00 event. The incoming technician repeats back only the maintenance ticket and does not mention the hold. What should happen before the handoff is considered complete?
choices: Nothing; the written note is enough even if the incoming worker missed one critical item
The outgoing technician should cross-check the missed hold status, clarify its effect on work, and confirm the incoming technician understands both open conditions and next actions
The incoming technician should sign the handoff first and ask questions later
The outgoing technician should remove the hold from the verbal handoff to keep the exchange shorter
rationale: Closed-loop handoff requires two-way exchange and cross-checking of critical open conditions. A missed hold is operationally significant, so it should be clarified and confirmed before responsibility is treated as successfully transferred.
